answer_spec: Columns: goods_description, SUM(customs_value_usd) of import declarations rounded to 2 decimals; the top 5 goods.

question: Which airports have shipments marked delivered that were never actually handed over?
question_template: Which airports have shipments marked delivered that were never actually handed over?

question: How late do completed flights leave in each kind of weather?
question_template: How late do completed flights leave in each kind of weather?
answer_spec: Columns: weather_at_departure, number of completed flights, average departure delay in minutes (actual - scheduled departure) rounded to 1 decimal; flights without weather omitted; ordered by delay DESC.

question: How much did we invoice each month in 2025, and what's the running total over the year?

gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT SUBSTRING(rech_kopf.ausst_dat, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) AS invoiced FROM rech_kopf AS rech_kopf WHERE rech_kopf.ausst_dat >= '2025-01-01' AND rech_kopf.ausst_dat < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(rech_kopf.ausst_dat, 1, 7)) SELECT m.month AS month, ROUND(m.invoiced, 2) AS invoiced_usd, ROUND(SUM(m.invoiced) OVER (ORDER BY m.month), 2) AS cumulative_usd FROM m AS m ORDER BY month

gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT SUBSTRING(flug.abfl_ist, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS completed_flights FROM flug AS flug WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(flug.abfl_ist, 1, 7)) SELECT m.month AS month, m.completed_flights AS completed_flights, m.completed_flights - LAG(m.completed_flights) OVER (ORDER BY m.month) AS change_vs_previous FROM m AS m ORDER BY month

question: Which 5 planes have the shortest average time on the ground between completed flights?
question_template: Which 5 planes have the shortest average time on the ground between completed flights?
answer_spec: Columns: tail_number, average ground time in hours between an aircraft's completed flight's actual arrival and its next completed flight's actual departure, rounded to 1 decimal; the 5 aircraft with the shortest average; ties by tail_number.
gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT flug.lfz_nr AS lfz_nr, flug.abfl_ist AS abfl_ist, LAG(flug.ank_ist) OVER (PARTITION BY flug.lfz_nr ORDER BY flug.abfl_ist) AS prev_arrival FROM flug AS flug WHERE flug.stat = 'completed') SELECT a.kennz AS kennz, ROUND(AVG((JULIANDAY(s.abfl_ist) - JULIANDAY(s.prev_arrival)) * 24), 1) AS avg_ground_hours FROM s AS s JOIN lfz AS a ON a.lfz_nr = s.lfz_nr WHERE NOT s.prev_arrival IS NULL GROUP BY a.lfz_nr, a.kennz ORDER BY avg_ground_hours ASC, kennz LIMIT 5

question: Which customers make up more than 4% of everything we invoiced, and what's their share?
question_template: Which customers make up more than 4% of everything we invoiced, and what's their share?
answer_spec: Columns: customer name, invoiced USD (rounded 2), share of all invoiced revenue in percent (rounded 2); customers with share above 4%; ordered by share DESC.

question: Rank the airports by how many tonnes of cargo flew out of them, and show the top 5 ranks.

question: For each plane model, how many completed flights were more than half full by volume?

question: Which 3 warehouses keep delivered goods the longest between arriving from the flight and handing them over?

answer_spec: Columns: warehouse_code, delivered shipments, average hours between the RCF and DLV events of the same shipment at that warehouse (rounded 2); warehouses with at least 20 such shipments; the 3 with the longest average.
gold_sql: SELECT w.lgr_cd AS lgr_cd, COUNT(*) AS deliveries, ROUND(AVG((JULIANDAY(d.ereig_zeit) - JULIANDAY(r.ereig_zeit)) * 24), 2) AS avg_dwell_hours FROM sdg_verfolg AS r JOIN sdg_verfolg AS d ON d.sndg_nr = r.sndg_nr AND d.ereig_cd = 'DLV' JOIN lgr AS w ON w.lgr_nr = r.lgr_nr WHERE r.ereig_cd = 'RCF' GROUP BY w.lgr_nr, w.lgr_cd HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY avg_dwell_hours DESC, lgr_cd LIMIT 3

gold_sql: SELECT w.lgr_cd AS lgr_cd, COUNT(*) AS deliveries, ROUND(AVG((JULIANDAY(d.ereig_zeit) - JULIANDAY(r.ereig_zeit)) * 24), 2) AS avg_dwell_hours FROM sdg_verfolg AS r JOIN sdg_verfolg AS d ON d.sndg_nr = r.sndg_nr AND d.ereig_cd = 'DLV' JOIN lgr AS w ON w.lgr_nr = r.lgr_nr WHERE r.ereig_cd = 'RCF' GROUP BY w.lgr_nr, w.lgr_cd HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY avg_dwell_hours DESC, lgr_cd LIMIT 3

question: At which 5 airports do shipments wait the longest between being dropped off and flying out?
question_template: At which 5 airports do shipments wait the longest between being dropped off and flying out?
answer_spec: Columns: origin iata_code, average hours between a shipment's RCS scan and its first DEP event (rounded 2); shipments that departed only; the 5 airports with the longest average.
gold_sql: WITH t AS (SELECT sdg_verfolg.sndg_nr AS sndg_nr, MIN(CASE WHEN sdg_verfolg.ereig_cd = 'RCS' THEN sdg_verfolg.ereig_zeit END) AS rcs, MIN(CASE WHEN sdg_verfolg.ereig_cd = 'DEP' THEN sdg_verfolg.ereig_zeit END) AS dep FROM sdg_verfolg AS sdg_verfolg GROUP BY sdg_verfolg.sndg_nr) SELECT a.iata_cd AS iata_cd, ROUND(AVG((JULIANDAY(t.dep) - JULIANDAY(t.rcs)) * 24), 2) AS avg_hours_rcs_to_departure FROM t AS t JOIN sndg AS s ON s.sndg_nr = t.sndg_nr JOIN flghf AS a ON a.fh_nr = s.urspr_fh WHERE NOT t.rcs IS NULL AND NOT t.dep IS NULL GROUP BY a.fh_nr, a.iata_cd ORDER BY avg_hours_rcs_to_departure DESC, iata_cd LIMIT 5

question: For each plane model, what was the single most expensive finished maintenance job?
question_template: For each plane model, what was the single most expensive finished maintenance job?
answer_spec: Columns: model, work_order_number, cost (parts + labour, rounded 2): per aircraft model the most expensive completed maintenance record; ordered by model.
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT t.mdl AS mdl, r.auftr_nr AS auftr_nr, r.teile_kost_usd + r.lohn_kost_usd AS cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.typ_nr ORDER BY r.teile_kost_usd + r.lohn_kost_usd DESC, r.auftr_nr) AS rn FROM wartg AS r JOIN lfz AS a ON a.lfz_nr = r.lfz_nr JOIN lfz_typ AS t ON t.typ_nr = a.typ_nr WHERE r.stat = 'completed') SELECT m.mdl AS mdl, m.auftr_nr AS auftr_nr, ROUND(m.cost, 2) AS cost_usd FROM m AS m WHERE m.rn = 1 ORDER BY mdl

question: For each airline, what percentage of completed flights left more than 15 minutes late?
question_template: For each airline, what percentage of completed flights left more than 15 minutes late?
answer_spec: Columns: airline name, completed flights, percentage departing more than 15 minutes late (rounded 1); ordered by percentage DESC.
gold_sql: SELECT al.bez AS airline_name, COUNT(*) AS completed_flights, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN (JULIANDAY(f.abfl_ist) - JULIANDAY(f.abfl_plan)) * 1440 > 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS late_departure_pct FROM flug AS f JOIN lfz AS a ON a.lfz_nr = f.lfz_nr JOIN flges AS al ON al.flges_nr = a.flges_nr WHERE f.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY al.flges_nr, al.bez ORDER BY late_departure_pct DESC, airline_name

question: At which connecting airports did two-leg shipments sit more than 48 hours between flights?
question_template: At which connecting airports did two-leg shipments sit more than 48 hours between flights?
answer_spec: Columns: connecting airport iata_code, number of two-leg shipments whose ground time there (leg 2 actual departure - leg 1 actual arrival) exceeded 48 hours; both legs flown; ordered by count DESC, iata_code.
gold_sql: SELECT a.iata_cd AS iata_cd, COUNT(*) AS long_connections FROM flug_ladg AS l1 JOIN flug_ladg AS l2 ON l2.sndg_nr = l1.sndg_nr AND l2.abschn_nr = 2 JOIN flug AS f1 ON f1.flug_id = l1.flug_id JOIN flug AS f2 ON f2.flug_id = l2.flug_id JOIN flghf AS a ON a.fh_nr = f1.ziel_fh WHERE l1.abschn_nr = 1 AND f1.stat = 'completed' AND f2.stat = 'completed' AND (JULIANDAY(f2.abfl_ist) - JULIANDAY(f1.ank_ist)) * 24 > 48 GROUP BY a.fh_nr, a.iata_cd ORDER BY long_connections DESC, iata_cd

question_template: Self-join [[flight_cargo]] legs 1 and 2 of the same shipment, both on completed [[flights]]; count cases where leg 2 [[flights.actual_departure]] - leg 1 [[flights.actual_arrival]] > 48 hours, per connecting [[airports.iata_code]].
answer_spec: Columns: connecting airport iata_code, number of two-leg shipments whose ground time there (leg 2 actual departure - leg 1 actual arrival) exceeded 48 hours; both legs flown; ordered by count DESC, iata_code.
gold_sql: SELECT a.iata_cd AS iata_cd, COUNT(*) AS long_connections FROM flug_ladg AS l1 JOIN flug_ladg AS l2 ON l2.sndg_nr = l1.sndg_nr AND l2.abschn_nr = 2 JOIN flug AS f1 ON f1.flug_id = l1.flug_id JOIN flug AS f2 ON f2.flug_id = l2.flug_id JOIN flghf AS a ON a.fh_nr = f1.ziel_fh WHERE l1.abschn_nr = 1 AND f1.stat = 'completed' AND f2.stat = 'completed' AND (JULIANDAY(f2.abfl_ist) - JULIANDAY(f1.ank_ist)) * 24 > 48 GROUP BY a.fh_nr, a.iata_cd ORDER BY long_connections DESC, iata_cd

question: Which airports had more completed departures in Q4 2025 than in Q3? Show both numbers.
question_template: Which airports had more completed departures in Q4 2025 than in Q3? Show both numbers.

question: If we split all shipments into four equal groups by weight, how many of the heaviest group belong to each type of goods?
question_template: If we split all shipments into four equal groups by weight, how many of the heaviest group belong to each type of goods?
answer_spec: Columns: commodity_category, number of its shipments in the heaviest quarter of all shipments (NTILE(4) over total_weight_kg, ties by shipment_id); ordered by count DESC, category.

question_template: Among customers with at least 20 shipments, which 5 book most often, measured by average days between bookings?

gold_sql: SELECT c.name1 AS name1, COUNT(*) AS shipments, ROUND((JULIANDAY(MAX(s.buch_dat)) - JULIANDAY(MIN(s.buch_dat))) / (COUNT(*) - 1), 2) AS avg_days_between_bookings FROM knd_stamm AS c JOIN sndg AS s ON s.kunnr = c.kunnr WHERE s.stat <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.kunnr, c.name1 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY avg_days_between_bookings ASC, c.kunnr LIMIT 5

question: Which planes flew more hours than the average plane of their own airline?
question_template: Which planes flew more hours than the average plane of their own airline?
answer_spec: Columns: airline name, tail_number, completed block hours (rounded 1) of aircraft whose completed block hours exceed the average of their airline's flying aircraft; ordered by airline name, hours DESC.
gold_sql: WITH h AS (SELECT a.flges_nr AS flges_nr, a.kennz AS kennz, SUM((JULIANDAY(f.ank_ist) - JULIANDAY(f.abfl_ist)) * 24) AS hours FROM flug AS f JOIN lfz AS a ON a.lfz_nr = f.lfz_nr WHERE f.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY a.lfz_nr, a.flges_nr, a.kennz), avg_h AS (SELECT h.flges_nr AS flges_nr, AVG(h.hours) AS avg_hours FROM h AS h GROUP BY h.flges_nr) SELECT al.bez AS airline_name, h.kennz AS kennz, ROUND(h.hours, 1) AS block_hours FROM h AS h JOIN avg_h AS avg_h ON avg_h.flges_nr = h.flges_nr JOIN flges AS al ON al.flges_nr = h.flges_nr WHERE h.hours > avg_h.avg_hours ORDER BY airline_name, block_hours DESC

question: Which 5 routes with at least 10 loaded completed flights have the highest average load by weight?
question_template: Which 5 routes with at least 10 loaded completed flights have the highest average load by weight?
answer_spec: Columns: origin iata, destination iata, flights, average payload load factor in percent (cargo kg on the flight / max_payload_kg * 100, rounded 1) over completed flights carrying cargo; routes with at least 10 such flights; top 5 by load factor.
gold_sql: WITH l AS (SELECT fc.flug_id AS flug_id, SUM(s.ges_gew_kg) AS kg FROM flug_ladg AS fc JOIN sndg AS s ON s.sndg_nr = fc.sndg_nr GROUP BY fc.flug_id) SELECT o.iata_cd AS origin, d.iata_cd AS destination, COUNT(*) AS flights, ROUND(AVG(l.kg * 100.0 / t.max_nutzl_kg), 1) AS avg_load_factor_pct FROM l AS l JOIN flug AS f ON f.flug_id = l.flug_id AND f.stat = 'completed' JOIN lfz AS a ON a.lfz_nr = f.lfz_nr JOIN lfz_typ AS t ON t.typ_nr = a.typ_nr JOIN flghf AS o ON o.fh_nr = f.abfl_fh JOIN flghf AS d ON d.fh_nr = f.ziel_fh GROUP BY o.iata_cd, d.iata_cd HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY avg_load_factor_pct DESC, origin, destination LIMIT 5

question: For each airline, how often did a flight leave over an hour late right after the same plane's previous flight arrived over an hour late?
question_template: For each airline, how often did a flight leave over an hour late right after the same plane's previous flight arrived over an hour late?
answer_spec: Columns: airline name, number of completed flights departing more than 60 minutes late whose aircraft's previous completed flight arrived more than 60 minutes late; ordered by count DESC, name.
gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT f.lfz_nr AS lfz_nr, (JULIANDAY(f.abfl_ist) - JULIANDAY(f.abfl_plan)) * 1440 AS dep_delay, LAG((JULIANDAY(f.ank_ist) - JULIANDAY(f.ank_plan)) * 1440) OVER (PARTITION BY f.lfz_nr ORDER BY f.abfl_ist) AS prev_arr_delay FROM flug AS f WHERE f.stat = 'completed') SELECT al.bez AS airline_name, COUNT(*) AS knock_on_delays FROM s AS s JOIN lfz AS a ON a.lfz_nr = s.lfz_nr JOIN flges AS al ON al.flges_nr = a.flges_nr WHERE s.dep_delay > 60 AND s.prev_arr_delay > 60 GROUP BY al.flges_nr, al.bez ORDER BY knock_on_delays DESC, airline_name

question_template: Using LAG over each aircraft's completed [[flights]] by [[flights.actual_departure]], count flights with departure delay > 60 min whose previous flight's arrival delay > 60 min, per [[airlines.name]].
answer_spec: Columns: airline name, number of completed flights departing more than 60 minutes late whose aircraft's previous completed flight arrived more than 60 minutes late; ordered by count DESC, name.
gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT f.lfz_nr AS lfz_nr, (JULIANDAY(f.abfl_ist) - JULIANDAY(f.abfl_plan)) * 1440 AS dep_delay, LAG((JULIANDAY(f.ank_ist) - JULIANDAY(f.ank_plan)) * 1440) OVER (PARTITION BY f.lfz_nr ORDER BY f.abfl_ist) AS prev_arr_delay FROM flug AS f WHERE f.stat = 'completed') SELECT al.bez AS airline_name, COUNT(*) AS knock_on_delays FROM s AS s JOIN lfz AS a ON a.lfz_nr = s.lfz_nr JOIN flges AS al ON al.flges_nr = a.flges_nr WHERE s.dep_delay > 60 AND s.prev_arr_delay > 60 GROUP BY al.flges_nr, al.bez ORDER BY knock_on_delays DESC, airline_name

question: At which airports did export customs clear less than 2 hours before the plane actually left?

answer_spec: Columns: origin iata_code, number of cleared export declarations cleared less than 2 hours before the shipment's leg-1 actual departure; airports with none omitted; ordered by count DESC, iata_code.
gold_sql: SELECT a.iata_cd AS iata_cd, COUNT(*) AS last_minute_clearances FROM zoll_anm AS d JOIN flug_ladg AS fc ON fc.sndg_nr = d.sndg_nr AND fc.abschn_nr = 1 JOIN flug AS f ON f.flug_id = fc.flug_id JOIN flghf AS a ON a.fh_nr = f.abfl_fh WHERE d.anm_art = 'export' AND d.stat = 'cleared' AND f.stat = 'completed' AND (JULIANDAY(f.abfl_ist) - JULIANDAY(d.freigabe)) * 24 < 2 GROUP BY a.fh_nr, a.iata_cd ORDER BY last_minute_clearances DESC, iata_cd

answer_spec: Columns: customer name, most frequent destination iata_code of their non-cancelled shipments, shipments to it; customers with at least 60 non-cancelled shipments; ties by iata_code; ordered by customer_id.
gold_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT s.kunnr AS kunnr, a.iata_cd AS iata_cd, COUNT(*) AS n FROM sndg AS s JOIN flghf AS a ON a.fh_nr = s.ziel_fh WHERE s.stat <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY s.kunnr, a.iata_cd), r AS (SELECT c.kunnr AS kunnr, c.iata_cd AS iata_cd, c.n AS n, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.kunnr ORDER BY c.n DESC, c.iata_cd) AS rn, SUM(c.n) OVER (PARTITION BY c.kunnr) AS total FROM c AS c) SELECT cu.name1 AS name1, r.iata_cd AS top_destination, r.n AS shipments FROM r AS r JOIN knd_stamm AS cu ON cu.kunnr = r.kunnr WHERE r.rn = 1 AND r.total >= 60 ORDER BY r.kunnr

question: For invoices paid in exactly two payments, how many days are there between the two, by type of customer?
question_template: For invoices paid in exactly two payments, how many days are there between the two, by type of customer?
answer_spec: Columns: customer_type, invoices paid in exactly two payments, average days between the first and second payment (rounded 1); ordered by customer_type.
gold_sql: WITH two AS (SELECT zahlg.rech_id AS rech_id, MIN(zahlg.zahl_dat) AS first_pay, MAX(zahlg.zahl_dat) AS second_pay FROM zahlg AS zahlg GROUP BY zahlg.rech_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 2) SELECT c.knd_typ AS knd_typ, COUNT(*) AS two_part_invoices, ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(t.second_pay) - JULIANDAY(t.first_pay)), 1) AS avg_days_between FROM two AS t JOIN rech_kopf AS i ON i.rech_id = t.rech_id JOIN sndg AS s ON s.sndg_nr = i.sndg_nr JOIN knd_stamm AS c ON c.kunnr = s.kunnr GROUP BY c.knd_typ ORDER BY knd_typ

question: In each sales region, which customer have we invoiced the most, and how much?
question_template: In each sales region, which customer have we invoiced the most, and how much?
answer_spec: Columns: sales_region, customer name, invoiced USD rounded to 2: per sales region the customer with the largest SUM(invoices.amount_usd) (ties: smaller customer_id); ordered by sales_region.
gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT c.kunnr AS kunnr, c.name1 AS name1, c.vertr_reg AS vertr_reg, SUM(i.brutto_usd) AS invoiced FROM rech_kopf AS i JOIN sndg AS s ON s.sndg_nr = i.sndg_nr JOIN knd_stamm AS c ON c.kunnr = s.kunnr GROUP BY c.kunnr, c.name1, c.vertr_reg), k AS (SELECT r.kunnr AS kunnr, r.name1 AS name1, r.vertr_reg AS vertr_reg, r.invoiced AS invoiced, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.vertr_reg ORDER BY r.invoiced DESC, r.kunnr) AS rn FROM r AS r) SELECT k.vertr_reg AS vertr_reg, k.name1 AS name1, ROUND(k.invoiced, 2) AS invoiced_usd FROM k AS k WHERE k.rn = 1 ORDER BY vertr_reg

question: What did we spend on fuel each month, and what's the three-month moving average?
question_template: What did we spend on fuel each month, and what's the three-month moving average?
answer_spec: Columns: month 'YYYY-MM' of uplift_time, fuel cost that month, 3-month moving average (this month and the 2 before; fewer at the start), both rounded to 2; ordered by month.
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT SUBSTRING(betankg.betank_zeit, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(betankg.ges_kost_usd) AS cost FROM betankg AS betankg GROUP BY SUBSTRING(betankg.betank_zeit, 1, 7)) SELECT m.month AS month, ROUND(m.cost, 2) AS fuel_cost_usd, ROUND(AVG(m.cost) OVER (ORDER BY m.month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS moving_avg_3m_usd FROM m AS m ORDER BY month

question: Which five planes went the longest between two maintenance jobs, and how many days was that?
question_template: Which five planes went the longest between two maintenance jobs, and how many days was that?
answer_spec: Columns: tail_number, longest gap in days between the start_time of two consecutive completed maintenance records of the same aircraft (rounded 1); the 5 aircraft with the longest gap.
gold_sql: WITH g AS (SELECT wartg.lfz_nr AS lfz_nr, JULIANDAY(wartg.beginn) - JULIANDAY(LAG(wartg.beginn) OVER (PARTITION BY wartg.lfz_nr ORDER BY wartg.beginn)) AS gap_days FROM wartg AS wartg WHERE wartg.stat = 'completed') SELECT a.kennz AS kennz, ROUND(MAX(g.gap_days), 1) AS longest_gap_days FROM g AS g JOIN lfz AS a ON a.lfz_nr = g.lfz_nr GROUP BY a.lfz_nr, a.kennz ORDER BY MAX(g.gap_days) DESC LIMIT 5

question: In each airline, which captain has logged the most block hours as captain, and how many?
question_template: In each airline, which captain has logged the most block hours as captain, and how many?
answer_spec: Columns: airline name, captain employee_number, credited block hours (SUM(block_minutes_credited)/60 over completed assignments in the 'captain' duty role, rounded 1): per airline the captain with most hours (ties: employee_number); ordered by airline name.
gold_sql: WITH h AS (SELECT m.flges_nr AS flges_nr, m.ma_nr AS ma_nr, SUM(ca.block_min) AS minutes FROM bes_eins AS ca JOIN bes_mitgl AS m ON m.pers_nr = ca.pers_nr WHERE ca.funktion = 'captain' AND ca.eins_stat = 'completed' GROUP BY m.pers_nr, m.flges_nr, m.ma_nr), r AS (SELECT h.flges_nr AS flges_nr, h.ma_nr AS ma_nr, h.minutes AS minutes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY h.flges_nr ORDER BY h.minutes DESC, h.ma_nr) AS rn FROM h AS h) SELECT al.bez AS airline_name, r.ma_nr AS ma_nr, ROUND(r.minutes / 60.0, 1) AS block_hours FROM r AS r JOIN flges AS al ON al.flges_nr = r.flges_nr WHERE r.rn = 1 ORDER BY airline_name

question: Which customers did we invoice more than 1.5 times as much in the second half of 2025 as in the first half?
question_template: Which customers did we invoice more than 1.5 times as much in the second half of 2025 as in the first half?
answer_spec: Columns: customer name, invoiced USD in H1 2025 (issued Jan-Jun), in H2 2025 (Jul-Dec), both rounded 2; customers whose H2 amount is more than 1.5 times the H1 amount; ordered by name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name1 AS name1, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i.ausst_dat < '2025-07-01' THEN i.brutto_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS h1_usd, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i.ausst_dat >= '2025-07-01' THEN i.brutto_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS h2_usd FROM rech_kopf AS i JOIN sndg AS s ON s.sndg_nr = i.sndg_nr JOIN knd_stamm AS c ON c.kunnr = s.kunnr WHERE i.ausst_dat >= '2025-01-01' AND i.ausst_dat < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.kunnr, c.name1 HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN i.ausst_dat >= '2025-07-01' THEN i.brutto_usd ELSE 0 END) > 1.5 * SUM(CASE WHEN i.ausst_dat < '2025-07-01' THEN i.brutto_usd ELSE 0 END) ORDER BY name1

gold_sql: SELECT c.name1 AS name1, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i.ausst_dat < '2025-07-01' THEN i.brutto_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS h1_usd, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i.ausst_dat >= '2025-07-01' THEN i.brutto_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS h2_usd FROM rech_kopf AS i JOIN sndg AS s ON s.sndg_nr = i.sndg_nr JOIN knd_stamm AS c ON c.kunnr = s.kunnr WHERE i.ausst_dat >= '2025-01-01' AND i.ausst_dat < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.kunnr, c.name1 HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN i.ausst_dat >= '2025-07-01' THEN i.brutto_usd ELSE 0 END) > 1.5 * SUM(CASE WHEN i.ausst_dat < '2025-07-01' THEN i.brutto_usd ELSE 0 END) ORDER BY name1

question: Which five customers owe us the most on invoices that aren't fully paid?
question_template: Which five customers owe us the most on invoices that aren't fully paid?
answer_spec: Columns: customer name, open balance in USD = invoice amount minus payments received, summed over its invoices with status 'unpaid' or 'partially_paid' (rounded 2); the 5 customers with the largest open balance.
gold_sql: WITH paid AS (SELECT zahlg.rech_id AS rech_id, SUM(zahlg.betr_usd) AS paid_usd FROM zahlg AS zahlg GROUP BY zahlg.rech_id) SELECT c.name1 AS name1, ROUND(SUM(i.brutto_usd - COALESCE(p.paid_usd, 0)), 2) AS open_balance_usd FROM rech_kopf AS i LEFT JOIN paid AS p ON p.rech_id = i.rech_id JOIN sndg AS s ON s.sndg_nr = i.sndg_nr JOIN knd_stamm AS c ON c.kunnr = s.kunnr WHERE i.stat IN ('unpaid', 'partially_paid') GROUP BY c.kunnr, c.name1 ORDER BY open_balance_usd DESC LIMIT 5

question: What's the median chargeable weight of delivered shipments for each service level?
question_template: What's the median chargeable weight of delivered shipments for each service level?
answer_spec: Columns: service_level, median chargeable_weight_kg of its delivered shipments (mean of the two middle values when the count is even, rounded 1); ordered by service_level.
gold_sql: WITH o AS (SELECT sndg.serv_lvl AS serv_lvl, sndg.fracht_gew_kg AS fracht_gew_kg, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sndg.serv_lvl ORDER BY sndg.fracht_gew_kg) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY sndg.serv_lvl) AS n FROM sndg AS sndg WHERE sndg.stat = 'delivered') SELECT o.serv_lvl AS serv_lvl, ROUND(AVG(o.fracht_gew_kg), 1) AS median_chargeable_kg FROM o AS o WHERE o.rn IN ((o.n + 1) / 2, (o.n + 2) / 2) GROUP BY o.serv_lvl ORDER BY serv_lvl

answer_spec: Columns: service_level of each customer's first shipment (earliest booking_date, ties by smaller shipment_id, any status), number of customers; ordered by service_level.
gold_sql: WITH f AS (SELECT sndg.kunnr AS kunnr, sndg.serv_lvl AS serv_lvl, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sndg.kunnr ORDER BY sndg.buch_dat, sndg.sndg_nr) AS rn FROM sndg AS sndg) SELECT f.serv_lvl AS serv_lvl, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM f AS f WHERE f.rn = 1 GROUP BY f.serv_lvl ORDER BY serv_lvl

question: After an AOG repair, how many hours does it take before the plane flies again, by airline?
question_template: After an AOG repair, how many hours does it take before the plane flies again, by airline?
answer_spec: Columns: airline name, AOG maintenance events (completed, is_aog = 1) followed by a completed flight of the same aircraft, average hours from the maintenance end_time to that aircraft's first completed departure after it (rounded 1); ordered by airline name.
gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT a.flges_nr AS flges_nr, (SELECT MIN(f.abfl_ist) AS _col_0 FROM flug AS f WHERE f.lfz_nr = m.lfz_nr AND f.stat = 'completed' AND f.abfl_ist >= m.ende) AS next_departure, m.ende AS ende FROM wartg AS m JOIN lfz AS a ON a.lfz_nr = m.lfz_nr WHERE m.aog_kz = 1 AND m.stat = 'completed') SELECT al.bez AS airline_name, COUNT(*) AS aog_events, ROUND(AVG((JULIANDAY(r.next_departure) - JULIANDAY(r.ende)) * 24), 1) AS avg_hours_to_next_departure FROM r AS r JOIN flges AS al ON al.flges_nr = r.flges_nr WHERE NOT r.next_departure IS NULL GROUP BY al.flges_nr, al.bez ORDER BY airline_name

question: What are the three busiest routes of each airline?
question_template: What are the three busiest routes of each airline?
answer_spec: Columns: airline name, origin iata_code, destination iata_code, completed flights: each airline's 3 busiest directed routes (ties: origin code, then destination code); ordered by airline name, flights DESC, origin, destination.
gold_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT a.flges_nr AS flges_nr, o.iata_cd AS origin, d.iata_cd AS destination, COUNT(*) AS flights FROM flug AS f JOIN lfz AS a ON a.lfz_nr = f.lfz_nr JOIN flghf AS o ON o.fh_nr = f.abfl_fh JOIN flghf AS d ON d.fh_nr = f.ziel_fh WHERE f.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY a.flges_nr, o.iata_cd, d.iata_cd), r AS (SELECT c.flges_nr AS flges_nr, c.origin AS origin, c.destination AS destination, c.flights AS flights, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.flges_nr ORDER BY c.flights DESC, c.origin, c.destination) AS rn FROM c AS c) SELECT al.bez AS airline_name, r.origin AS origin, r.destination AS destination, r.flights AS flights FROM r AS r JOIN flges AS al ON al.flges_nr = r.flges_nr WHERE r.rn <= 3 ORDER BY airline_name, r.flights DESC, r.origin, r.destination

question_template: Which pilots with at least 20 completed duties are pilot flying less than 35% of the time?

question: How do our unpaid invoices age as of 20 December 2025: not due, 1-30, 31-60 and over 60 days late?
question_template: How do our unpaid invoices age as of 20 December 2025: not due, 1-30, 31-60 and over 60 days late?
answer_spec: Columns: ageing bucket of invoices with status not 'paid' by days past due_date on 2025-12-20 ('not due', '1-30', '31-60', '61+'), number of invoices, SUM(amount_usd) rounded 2; ordered by the bucket order above.
gold_sql: WITH b AS (SELECT rech_kopf.brutto_usd AS brutto_usd, CASE WHEN JULIANDAY('2025-12-20') - JULIANDAY(rech_kopf.faell_dat) <= 0 THEN 'not due' WHEN JULIANDAY('2025-12-20') - JULIANDAY(rech_kopf.faell_dat) <= 30 THEN '1-30' WHEN JULIANDAY('2025-12-20') - JULIANDAY(rech_kopf.faell_dat) <= 60 THEN '31-60' ELSE '61+' END AS bucket FROM rech_kopf AS rech_kopf WHERE rech_kopf.stat <> 'paid') SELECT b.bucket AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS invoices, ROUND(SUM(b.brutto_usd), 2) AS amount_usd FROM b AS b GROUP BY b.bucket ORDER BY CASE bucket WHEN 'not due' THEN 0 WHEN '1-30' THEN 1 WHEN '31-60' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

gold_sql: WITH b AS (SELECT rech_kopf.brutto_usd AS brutto_usd, CASE WHEN JULIANDAY('2025-12-20') - JULIANDAY(rech_kopf.faell_dat) <= 0 THEN 'not due' WHEN JULIANDAY('2025-12-20') - JULIANDAY(rech_kopf.faell_dat) <= 30 THEN '1-30' WHEN JULIANDAY('2025-12-20') - JULIANDAY(rech_kopf.faell_dat) <= 60 THEN '31-60' ELSE '61+' END AS bucket FROM rech_kopf AS rech_kopf WHERE rech_kopf.stat <> 'paid') SELECT b.bucket AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS invoices, ROUND(SUM(b.brutto_usd), 2) AS amount_usd FROM b AS b GROUP BY b.bucket ORDER BY CASE bucket WHEN 'not due' THEN 0 WHEN '1-30' THEN 1 WHEN '31-60' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

question_template: Per [[airlines.name]], count completed [[flights]] per month of [[flights.actual_departure]] and keep the month with most (ties: earlier month) with its count.
answer_spec: Columns: airline name, month 'YYYY-MM' (by actual_departure) with the most completed flights for that airline (ties: earlier month), completed flights that month; ordered by airline name.
gold_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT a.flges_nr AS flges_nr, SUBSTRING(f.abfl_ist, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS flights FROM flug AS f JOIN lfz AS a ON a.lfz_nr = f.lfz_nr WHERE f.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY a.flges_nr, SUBSTRING(f.abfl_ist, 1, 7)), r AS (SELECT c.flges_nr AS flges_nr, c.month AS month, c.flights AS flights, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.flges_nr ORDER BY c.flights DESC, c.month) AS rn FROM c AS c) SELECT al.bez AS airline_name, r.month AS month, r.flights AS flights FROM r AS r JOIN flges AS al ON al.flges_nr = r.flges_nr WHERE r.rn = 1 ORDER BY airline_name

question: On average, how many crew are on a completed flight, for each aircraft model?
question_template: On average, how many crew are on a completed flight, for each aircraft model?
answer_spec: Columns: model, average number of crew assigned per completed flight (rounded 2); ordered by model.
gold_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT ca.flug_id AS flug_id, COUNT(*) AS crew FROM bes_eins AS ca GROUP BY ca.flug_id) SELECT t.mdl AS mdl, ROUND(AVG(c.crew), 2) AS avg_crew_per_flight FROM flug AS f JOIN c AS c ON c.flug_id = f.flug_id JOIN lfz AS a ON a.lfz_nr = f.lfz_nr JOIN lfz_typ AS t ON t.typ_nr = a.typ_nr WHERE f.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY t.typ_nr, t.mdl ORDER BY mdl

question: Among customers with at least 30 payments, which five pay late most often?
question_template: Among customers with at least 30 payments, which five pay late most often?
answer_spec: Columns: customer name, payments, share of payments made after the invoice's due_date in percent (rounded 1); customers with at least 30 payments; the 5 with the highest late share.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name1 AS name1, COUNT(*) AS payments, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.zahl_dat > i.faell_dat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS late_pct FROM zahlg AS p JOIN rech_kopf AS i ON i.rech_id = p.rech_id JOIN knd_stamm AS c ON c.kunnr = p.kunnr GROUP BY c.kunnr, c.name1 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 ORDER BY 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.zahl_dat > i.faell_dat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which captains have flown with at least 11 different first officers?
question_template: Which captains have flown with at least 11 different first officers?
answer_spec: Columns: captain employee_number, number of different first officers flown with (completed assignments, roles captain and first_officer on the same flight); captains with at least 11; ordered by count DESC, employee_number.
gold_sql: SELECT m.ma_nr AS ma_nr, COUNT(DISTINCT fo.pers_nr) AS distinct_first_officers FROM bes_eins AS cp JOIN bes_eins AS fo ON fo.flug_id = cp.flug_id AND fo.funktion = 'first_officer' AND fo.eins_stat = 'completed' JOIN bes_mitgl AS m ON m.pers_nr = cp.pers_nr WHERE cp.funktion = 'captain' AND cp.eins_stat = 'completed' GROUP BY m.pers_nr, m.ma_nr HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fo.pers_nr) >= 11 ORDER BY distinct_first_officers DESC, ma_nr

question: Which airports have worse average arrival delays than the network as a whole?
question_template: Which airports have worse average arrival delays than the network as a whole?
answer_spec: Columns: destination iata_code, average arrival delay in minutes of completed flights there (rounded 1); only airports whose average is above the average over all completed flights; ordered by delay DESC.
gold_sql: SELECT ap.iata_cd AS iata_cd, ROUND(AVG((JULIANDAY(f.ank_ist) - JULIANDAY(f.ank_plan)) * 1440), 1) AS avg_arrival_delay_min FROM flug AS f JOIN flghf AS ap ON ap.fh_nr = f.ziel_fh WHERE f.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY ap.fh_nr, ap.iata_cd HAVING AVG((JULIANDAY(f.ank_ist) - JULIANDAY(f.ank_plan)) * 1440) > (SELECT AVG((JULIANDAY(flug.ank_ist) - JULIANDAY(flug.ank_plan)) * 1440) AS _col_0 FROM flug AS flug WHERE flug.stat = 'completed') ORDER BY avg_arrival_delay_min DESC

question: When both customs clearances go through, how many hours pass between export and import clearance, by import country?

gold_sql: SELECT im.zoll_land AS zoll_land, COUNT(*) AS shipments, ROUND(AVG((JULIANDAY(im.freigabe) - JULIANDAY(ex.freigabe)) * 24), 1) AS avg_hours_export_to_import FROM zoll_anm AS im JOIN zoll_anm AS ex ON ex.sndg_nr = im.sndg_nr AND ex.anm_art = 'export' AND ex.stat = 'cleared' WHERE im.anm_art = 'import' AND im.stat = 'cleared' GROUP BY im.zoll_land HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY avg_hours_export_to_import DESC, zoll_land

answer_spec: Columns: sales_region, customer name, non-cancelled shipments, dense rank within the region: customers ranked 1 to 2 by shipments in their sales region (ties share a rank); ordered by region, rank, name.
gold_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT cu.vertr_reg AS vertr_reg, cu.name1 AS name1, COUNT(*) AS shipments FROM sndg AS s JOIN knd_stamm AS cu ON cu.kunnr = s.kunnr WHERE s.stat <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY cu.kunnr, cu.vertr_reg, cu.name1), r AS (SELECT c.vertr_reg AS vertr_reg, c.name1 AS name1, c.shipments AS shipments, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.vertr_reg ORDER BY c.shipments DESC) AS region_rank FROM c AS c) SELECT r.vertr_reg AS vertr_reg, r.name1 AS name1, r.shipments AS shipments, r.region_rank AS region_rank FROM r AS r WHERE r.region_rank <= 2 ORDER BY vertr_reg, region_rank, name1

question: If we split customers into five equal groups by revenue, how much does each group bring in and what share is that?
question_template: If we split customers into five equal groups by revenue, how much does each group bring in and what share is that?
answer_spec: Columns: revenue quintile (NTILE(5) over customers by invoiced USD DESC, ties by customer_id; 1 = top), customers in it, invoiced USD (rounded 2), share of all invoiced revenue in percent (rounded 1); ordered by quintile.
gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT s.kunnr AS kunnr, SUM(i.brutto_usd) AS revenue FROM rech_kopf AS i JOIN sndg AS s ON s.sndg_nr = i.sndg_nr GROUP BY s.kunnr), q AS (SELECT r.kunnr AS kunnr, r.revenue AS revenue, NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY r.revenue DESC, r.kunnr) AS quintile FROM r AS r) SELECT q.quintile AS quintile, COUNT(*) AS customers, ROUND(SUM(q.revenue), 2) AS invoiced_usd, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(q.revenue) / (SELECT SUM(r.revenue) AS _col_0 FROM r AS r), 1) AS share_pct FROM q AS q GROUP BY q.quintile ORDER BY quintile

question_template: Cold chain gaps?
answer_spec: Columns: origin iata_code, temperature-controlled shipments (any status) originating there; only airports without any 'cold_chain' warehouse; ordered by count DESC, iata_code.
gold_sql: SELECT ap.iata_cd AS iata_cd, COUNT(*) AS temp_controlled_shipments FROM sndg AS s JOIN flghf AS ap ON ap.fh_nr = s.urspr_fh WHERE s.temp_kz = 1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 AS "1" FROM lgr AS w WHERE w.fh_nr = ap.fh_nr AND w.lgr_typ = 'cold_chain') GROUP BY ap.fh_nr, ap.iata_cd ORDER BY temp_controlled_shipments DESC, iata_cd

question: How many flights were cancelled because of weather in each month of 2025, including months with none?
question_template: How many flights were cancelled because of weather in each month of 2025, including months with none?
answer_spec: Columns: every month '2025-01' to '2025-12', number of flights with cancellation_reason 'weather' scheduled that month (0 when none); ordered by month.
gold_sql: WITH RECURSIVE months(m) AS (SELECT '2025-01-01' AS m UNION ALL SELECT DATE(months.m, '+1 month') AS m FROM months AS months WHERE months.m < '2025-12-01') SELECT SUBSTRING(months.m, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(f.flug_id) AS weather_cancellations FROM months AS months LEFT JOIN flug AS f ON SUBSTRING(f.abfl_plan, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING(months.m, 1, 7) AND f.storno_grund = 'weather' GROUP BY months.m ORDER BY month

question: Which planes flew on three or more days in a row, and what's their longest streak?
question_template: Which planes flew on three or more days in a row, and what's their longest streak?
answer_spec: Columns: tail_number, longest run of consecutive calendar days with at least one completed departure (by date of actual_departure); aircraft with a run of at least 3 days; ordered by run DESC, tail_number.
gold_sql: WITH d AS (SELECT DISTINCT flug.lfz_nr AS lfz_nr, DATE(flug.abfl_ist) AS day FROM flug AS flug WHERE flug.stat = 'completed'), g AS (SELECT d.lfz_nr AS lfz_nr, d.day AS day, JULIANDAY(d.day) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.lfz_nr ORDER BY d.day) AS grp FROM d AS d), runs AS (SELECT g.lfz_nr AS lfz_nr, g.grp AS grp, COUNT(*) AS run_days FROM g AS g GROUP BY g.lfz_nr, g.grp) SELECT a.kennz AS kennz, MAX(r.run_days) AS longest_run_days FROM runs AS r JOIN lfz AS a ON a.lfz_nr = r.lfz_nr GROUP BY a.lfz_nr, a.kennz HAVING MAX(r.run_days) >= 3 ORDER BY longest_run_days DESC, kennz

question: Which customers have an average invoice at least 1.5 times the average for their customer type?
question_template: Which customers have an average invoice at least 1.5 times the average for their customer type?
answer_spec: Columns: customer name, customer_type, average invoice amount_usd of the customer, average over the customers of the same type (mean of the customer averages), both rounded 2; customers at least 1.5 times their type average; ordered by customer_type, name.
gold_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT cu.kunnr AS kunnr, cu.name1 AS name1, cu.knd_typ AS knd_typ, AVG(i.brutto_usd) AS avg_invoice FROM rech_kopf AS i JOIN sndg AS s ON s.sndg_nr = i.sndg_nr JOIN knd_stamm AS cu ON cu.kunnr = s.kunnr GROUP BY cu.kunnr, cu.name1, cu.knd_typ), t AS (SELECT c.kunnr AS kunnr, c.name1 AS name1, c.knd_typ AS knd_typ, c.avg_invoice AS avg_invoice, AVG(c.avg_invoice) OVER (PARTITION BY c.knd_typ) AS type_avg FROM c AS c) SELECT t.name1 AS name1, t.knd_typ AS knd_typ, ROUND(t.avg_invoice, 2) AS avg_invoice_usd, ROUND(t.type_avg, 2) AS type_avg_usd FROM t AS t WHERE t.avg_invoice >= 1.5 * t.type_avg ORDER BY knd_typ, name1

question: For resolved incidents, how many days did they take to close by severity, and what share closed within 30 days?
question_template: For resolved incidents, how many days did they take to close by severity, and what share closed within 30 days?
answer_spec: Columns: severity, resolved incidents, average days from reported_at to resolved_at (rounded 1), share resolved within 30 days in percent (rounded 1); ordered by severity.
gold_sql: SELECT vorf.schwere AS schwere, COUNT(*) AS resolved_incidents, ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(vorf.erledigt_am) - JULIANDAY(vorf.meld_zeit)), 1) AS avg_days_to_resolve, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN JULIANDAY(vorf.erledigt_am) - JULIANDAY(vorf.meld_zeit) <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS within_30d_pct FROM vorf AS vorf WHERE vorf.erledigt_kz = 1 GROUP BY vorf.schwere ORDER BY schwere

question: For each commodity, which invoiced shipment earned the most per chargeable kilo?
question_template: For each commodity, which invoiced shipment earned the most per chargeable kilo?
answer_spec: Columns: commodity_category, awb_number, invoice USD per chargeable kg (amount_usd / chargeable_weight_kg, rounded 2): per category the invoiced shipment with the highest yield (ties: smaller shipment_id); ordered by category.
gold_sql: WITH y AS (SELECT s.waren_kat AS waren_kat, s.lbf_nr AS lbf_nr, s.sndg_nr AS sndg_nr, i.brutto_usd / s.fracht_gew_kg AS usd_per_kg FROM rech_kopf AS i JOIN sndg AS s ON s.sndg_nr = i.sndg_nr), r AS (SELECT y.waren_kat AS waren_kat, y.lbf_nr AS lbf_nr, y.sndg_nr AS sndg_nr, y.usd_per_kg AS usd_per_kg, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY y.waren_kat ORDER BY y.usd_per_kg DESC, y.sndg_nr) AS rn FROM y AS y) SELECT r.waren_kat AS waren_kat, r.lbf_nr AS lbf_nr, ROUND(r.usd_per_kg, 2) AS usd_per_chargeable_kg FROM r AS r WHERE r.rn = 1 ORDER BY waren_kat

question: In each month of Q4 2025, what share of completed flights did each airline operate?

answer_spec: Columns: month 'YYYY-MM' (Oct-Dec 2025, by actual_departure), airline name, completed flights, share of that month's completed flights in percent (rounded 1); ordered by month, flights DESC, airline name.
gold_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT SUBSTRING(f.abfl_ist, 1, 7) AS month, a.flges_nr AS flges_nr, COUNT(*) AS flights FROM flug AS f JOIN lfz AS a ON a.lfz_nr = f.lfz_nr WHERE f.stat = 'completed' AND f.abfl_ist >= '2025-10-01' AND f.abfl_ist < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(f.abfl_ist, 1, 7), a.flges_nr) SELECT c.month AS month, al.bez AS airline_name, c.flights AS flights, ROUND(100.0 * c.flights / SUM(c.flights) OVER (PARTITION BY c.month), 1) AS share_pct FROM c AS c JOIN flges AS al ON al.flges_nr = c.flges_nr ORDER BY c.month, c.flights DESC, airline_name

question_template: Airline share last quarter?
answer_spec: Columns: month 'YYYY-MM' (Oct-Dec 2025, by actual_departure), airline name, completed flights, share of that month's completed flights in percent (rounded 1); ordered by month, flights DESC, airline name.
gold_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT SUBSTRING(f.abfl_ist, 1, 7) AS month, a.flges_nr AS flges_nr, COUNT(*) AS flights FROM flug AS f JOIN lfz AS a ON a.lfz_nr = f.lfz_nr WHERE f.stat = 'completed' AND f.abfl_ist >= '2025-10-01' AND f.abfl_ist < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(f.abfl_ist, 1, 7), a.flges_nr) SELECT c.month AS month, al.bez AS airline_name, c.flights AS flights, ROUND(100.0 * c.flights / SUM(c.flights) OVER (PARTITION BY c.month), 1) AS share_pct FROM c AS c JOIN flges AS al ON al.flges_nr = c.flges_nr ORDER BY c.month, c.flights DESC, airline_name

question: For two-leg shipments, how often does the second leg go on a different airline, by first-leg airline?
question_template: For two-leg shipments, how often does the second leg go on a different airline, by first-leg airline?
answer_spec: Columns: airline name of leg 1, number of two-leg shipments whose leg 2 is flown by a different airline (interline); ordered by count DESC, name.
gold_sql: SELECT al.bez AS first_leg_airline, COUNT(*) AS interline_shipments FROM flug_ladg AS l1 JOIN flug_ladg AS l2 ON l2.sndg_nr = l1.sndg_nr AND l2.abschn_nr = 2 JOIN flug AS f1 ON f1.flug_id = l1.flug_id JOIN lfz AS a1 ON a1.lfz_nr = f1.lfz_nr JOIN flug AS f2 ON f2.flug_id = l2.flug_id JOIN lfz AS a2 ON a2.lfz_nr = f2.lfz_nr JOIN flges AS al ON al.flges_nr = a1.flges_nr WHERE l1.abschn_nr = 1 AND a1.flges_nr <> a2.flges_nr GROUP BY al.flges_nr, al.bez ORDER BY interline_shipments DESC, first_leg_airline

question: Self-join flug_ladg on sndg_nr (leg 1 and leg 2), map each leg to its airline via flug and lfz; count shipments where the airlines differ, per leg-1 bez; most first.
question_template: Self-join [[flight_cargo]] on [[flight_cargo.shipment_id]] (leg 1 and leg 2), map each leg to its airline via [[flights]] and [[aircraft]]; count shipments where the airlines differ, per leg-1 [[airlines.name]]; most first.
answer_spec: Columns: airline name of leg 1, number of two-leg shipments whose leg 2 is flown by a different airline (interline); ordered by count DESC, name.
gold_sql: SELECT al.bez AS first_leg_airline, COUNT(*) AS interline_shipments FROM flug_ladg AS l1 JOIN flug_ladg AS l2 ON l2.sndg_nr = l1.sndg_nr AND l2.abschn_nr = 2 JOIN flug AS f1 ON f1.flug_id = l1.flug_id JOIN lfz AS a1 ON a1.lfz_nr = f1.lfz_nr JOIN flug AS f2 ON f2.flug_id = l2.flug_id JOIN lfz AS a2 ON a2.lfz_nr = f2.lfz_nr JOIN flges AS al ON al.flges_nr = a1.flges_nr WHERE l1.abschn_nr = 1 AND a1.flges_nr <> a2.flges_nr GROUP BY al.flges_nr, al.bez ORDER BY interline_shipments DESC, first_leg_airline
